name: Start A Test Run
purpose: Developer test harness of the tester file: the first test of a run installs a 1-second reset timer, clears the test globals, opens the 'Show Running Tests' card, deletes every Test record, creates a fresh Test record with a Deleter key (a new UUID) and sets the counter to 1. A test started while another is running only increments the counter.
